description: This PHP script manages the repair or cleanup of uploaded files in the SuiteCRM system. It verifies admin permissions, iterates over upload directory files, cross-references them with database records via beans, and removes orphaned or deleted files, providing summary statistics.

classes.name: DirectoryIterator
classes.description: Built-in PHP class for iterating over filesystem directories.

methods.name: sugar_die
methods.description: Terminates execution with an error message if user lacks admin rights.
